description: Every runZero query, plus a local SQLite copy of your whole attack surface that diffs over time, joins assets to vulnerabilities offline, and costs zero API quota to re-slice.

novel_features.name: Attack-surface diff over time
novel_features.description: Show which assets, services, ports, and software appeared or disappeared between two local syncs.

novel_features.name: Exposure triage (criticality x vulnerability)
novel_features.description: Rank assets by criticality joined to their exposed services and high-severity vulnerability findings.

novel_features.name: CVE-to-fleet blast radius
novel_features.description: Given a CVE, list every affected asset with its services and criticality.

novel_features.name: Software/version fleet rollup
novel_features.description: Group installed software by product and version with a count of assets running each.

novel_features.name: Stale / EOL / unowned asset hygiene
novel_features.description: Bucket assets by last-seen age, end-of-life OS, and missing tag/owner — emitting IDs ready to pipe into the bulk commands.

novel_features.name: Service exposure by subnet
novel_features.description: Roll up which protocols and ports are exposed across a CIDR, asset-counted per service.

novel_features.name: Scan-watch (kick + follow to completion)
novel_features.description: Start a scan on a site and follow the task to completion in one command, with a typed exit code on the result.

novel_features.name: Exposure delta since last sync
novel_features.description: List services and ports that became newly exposed or newly vulnerable since the last sync, ranked by asset criticality.

novel_features.name: Certificate-expiry / weak-crypto watch
novel_features.description: List TLS certificates expiring within a window or using weak crypto, joined to the asset and service presenting them.
